headline: Halloween Candy Sales Decline 6.7% as High Cocoa Prices Squeeze Budgets
summary: U.S. Halloween confectionery sales dropped 6.7% as elevated cocoa costs and consumer living expenses prompted shoppers to pull back on chocolate and candy purchases.
why: Confectionery sales are an early barometer for holiday retail demand and reflect how soft commodity price shocks filter through to consumers.

impacts.name: Confectionery Manufacturers
impacts.why: Slowing sales volumes and high raw ingredient costs reduce consumer goods margins.
